collection.description: A new parent is recovering from childbirth and finds even familiar tasks exhausting.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A new parent is recovering from childbirth and finds even familiar tasks exhausting. Their partner, (name1), wants to help, but discovers that good intentions do not automatically reveal what the recovering parent needs.

choices.label: Take Over Routine Baby Care for a While
Arrange Practical Help from the Village
Sit Beside the Recovering Parent and Listen

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The recovering parent asks for food, clean bedding, and uninterrupted rest, and their partner provides it.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The recovering parent cannot decide, so they agree to start with a simple meal and check again later.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The recovering parent sleeps while their partner changes, carries, and soothes the newborn.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The baby remains unsettled, and the partner asks an experienced caregiver for assistance.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Friends bring meals and water, allowing the household to recover in peace.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Too many visitors arrive at once, and the partner kindly asks them to return another day.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: They speak openly about the birth, their fears, and the strange joy of meeting their child.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The recovering parent admits feeling overwhelmed; their partner listens and helps them seek further support.
